To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Bottom ash can be utilized for the production of geopolymer mortar, (2) The optimum compressive strength is obtained for Na2 SiO2 / NaOH molar ratio 2, (3) The optimum compressivestrength is obtained for NaOH/ SiO2 molar ratio 0.5, and (4) The optimum compressives strength is obtained with steam curing at 80oC for 24 hours.
the geopolymer mortars prepared with bottom ash as a source material and Na2 SiO2 / NaOH molar ratio of 2 and SiO2 /Al2O3 molar ratio of1.0 achieved the highest compressive strength of 30.5 MPa.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of geopolymer mortar from ground bottom ash and the effect of Na2 SiO 3/NaOH ratio on compressive strength.
the utilization of bottom ashes in geopolymer concrete, and the effect of curing conditions on the compressive strength of geopolymer mortars.
the feasibility of ground bottom ash as a source material in geopolymer concrete.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the compressive strength of geopolymer mortar is influenced by molar ratio of Na2 SiO /NaOH ratio, curing mode and curing duration.
the ground bottom ash can be used as an alternative material to fly ash in geopolymeric mortars.

the compressive strength of the ground bottom ash geopolymer mortars is higher under steam curing compared to ambient curing and also the compressive strength increases with increase in Na2 SiO2 / NaOH molar ratio and decrease in SiO2 /NA2 O molar ration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ground coal ash can be used as source material to produce geopolymer mortar and steam curing is a suitable curing mode to produce geopolyer mortar.
the geopolymer mortar with ground coal ash as binder can be used for structural applications.
ground bottom ash geopolymer has potential to be used in construction sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bottom ash is not only a viable alternative material in the production of coal ash geoplymer mortar but can also be used as an effective binder for construction sector.
the compressive strength of bottom ash geopolymer is higher than fly ash geopolymer.
bottom ash can be used in construction sector as a source material to make geopolymer mortar.
